verdict.rationale: Ollama's own docs and GitHub emphasize connecting it to third-party agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, Copilot) that let users issue natural-language commands, and OpenClaw specifically turns Ollama into a chat-driven assistant across Slack/Discord/WhatsApp — but Ollama itself is a CLI/REST-API model runner with structured commands (ollama run/pull), not a natural-language interface to itself. missing for 10: first-party NL command layer for managing Ollama (not just via third-party agents), hands-on evidence that agent-mediated NL control works reliably, independent corroboration beyond vendor docs.
